computer.guidance:
The computer tool drives Linux (X11) app windows through screenshots and synthesized input:
- Find the target with list_apps, then copy the exact linux:PID:XID:STARTTIME id into app. Give every call a short display_title; it names the visible activity.
- observe returns a target-only screenshot and a snapshot_id. Coordinates and inputs are valid only against the latest snapshot, and each input consumes it. On stale_snapshot, call observe once and retry with the fresh id; do not replay the failed call.
- Use sequence for multi-step input: every step needs risk, and non-safe steps need confirmed=true only after explicit user confirmation.
- Set after to "vision" to return a fresh screenshot with the input result instead of a separate observe call. Input delivery does not prove the outcome; verify with observe when it matters.
